# Egress

> Free browser tool that shows every exit IP a visitor's traffic uses. 51 probes are asked at once: sites in
> mainland China, IP lookup services, AI services and popular sites (Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/trace on each one's own domain),
> IPv4-only and IPv6-only hosts, and WebRTC STUN servers over UDP. The answers are grouped by network into exits
> (local line or proxy), and the page reports split routing, per-service routes, WebRTC leaks, IPv6 leaks and
> time-zone mismatches. Everything runs client-side; no results are sent to the site.

- Page: https://egress.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Probes: Sites in mainland China: myip.ipip.net, data.video.iqiyi.com, api.ipify.cn, ipv4.ddnspod.com, ipv6.ddnspod.com; IP lookup services: api.ip.sb, ipinfo.io, ipapi.co, ipwho.is, get.geojs.io, ipleak.net, ident.me, ip.guide, icanhazip.com, api.bigdatacloud.net; AI services: chatgpt.com, openai.com, sora.com, claude.ai, anthropic.com, grok.com, perplexity.ai, copilot.microsoft.com, mistral.ai, poe.com, character.ai, deepl.com; Popular sites: www.cloudflare.com, one.one.one.one, gitlab.com, registry.npmjs.org, notion.so, linear.app, zoom.us, medium.com, coinbase.com, crunchyroll.com, patreon.com, shopify.com; IPv4 only / IPv6 only: api-ipv4.ip.sb, api-ipv6.ip.sb, ipv4-check-perf.radar.cloudflare.com, ipv6-check-perf.radar.cloudflare.com, api4.ipify.org, api6.ipify.org, ipv4.icanhazip.com, ipv6.icanhazip.com; WebRTC (UDP): stun.cloudflare.com, stun.l.google.com, global.stun.twilio.com, stun.miwifi.com
- Source: https://github.com/yt1988/egresslens
